mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 3.5% and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for three consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased supply-side activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM growth exceeds 1% and the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with a demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4% and GDPC1 growth is negative, but the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a single month signals strong labor demand, which is associated with increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines by more than 2% MoM and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth is negative and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: supply contraction with labor market weakness
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is negative and UNRATE is rising, but the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
